lazar_plays.description: Stocks acquired by David Lazar / Lazar Capital. Pattern: he buys distressed shells via private placement, takes board control, redirects strategy. Often produces 50-200% pops on announcement.

crypto_treasury.description: Companies that have publicly announced building a crypto treasury (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL). When Bitcoin or BNB rallies, these names get sympathy bids. When they announce additional purchases, often pop 20-100%.

ai_rebrand.description: Companies that recently changed name or ticker to include AI/Fabric/Neural/Quantum branding. Often pump on rebrand announcement, then again on first AI revenue claim.

cannabis_basket.description: Cannabis/marijuana stocks. Move as a basket on DEA/SAFE Banking Act news. Schedule III reclassification in progress. Sympathy plays when one pops.

prediction_markets.description: Sports betting / prediction market plays. Sympathy on Polymarket / Kalshi flow, FIFA / NFL / election cycles.

biotech_binary.description: Small-cap biotechs with pending Phase 2/3 readouts or PDUFA dates that have shown 50%+ moves on data drops historically. Manual list, refresh quarterly.

small_cap_china_adr.description: Chinese small-cap ADRs known for low-float pumps with no fundamental catalyst. Avoid unless paired with another Tier S/A signal.

china_megacap_adrs.description: Chinese mega-cap ADRs not in S&P 500 / Russell universe. Cover BABA-style earnings, regulatory news, China stimulus catalysts. Big options markets, real liquidity, real catalysts. Force-include daily.

uk_dual_listed_adrs.description: UK names with both LSE and NYSE listings. NYSE side often has better options liquidity and catches US-driven moves. Force-include daily so catalysts surface in both venues.

mega_cap_ai_tech.description: Mega-cap AI/tech names that move on catalysts but get -2 mcap penalty in scoring. Override penalty since they're the actual leaders driving the cycle. Cover NVDA/AMD/QCOM/AMAT-style hyperscaler deal news.

ai_infra_pureplay.description: Pure-play AI infrastructure names not in standard indices yet. Cover Nebius-style hyperscaler-customer wins, data center buildouts, AI compute platforms. These are where the next 10x lives — businesses with >100% YoY revenue growth and confirmed hyperscaler deals. Force-include daily so earnings beats and Meta/Microsoft/OpenAI deal news always surfaces.

high_momentum_runners.description: Mid-cap names with documented history of 20%+ single-day moves on news. Cover thematic gaps between catalyst-driven scans: space launch/defense, quantum, nuclear/SMR, AI applications, robotics. Force-include daily so a major contract / launch / data drop catches them even without an EDGAR / earnings / analyst signal in our pipeline.

recent_gappers_30d.description: Auto-populated from backtest_gappers_30d.json — every US ticker that gapped >=25% on a single day in the trailing 30 days. These names are 'in motion' and frequently re-gap on follow-up news. Force-include daily so we catch continuation plays. Refresh monthly via scripts/backtest_gappers_30d.py + scripts/refresh_recent_gappers_cohort.py.
